project_description: Create a generic terminal-decision extension platform with one exclusive provisional-terminal provider in FeatureBundle, one core terminal chokepoint, core-owned transactional continuation, immutable generation activation and withdrawal, and a bounded process-owned secure-session policy with independent client/operator tri-state controls. Provide generic authenticated policy endpoints, preserve existing lifecycle and authority owners, make concrete Agent Loop Guard removable from core, and enforce failure schedules, architecture ratchets, ROI evidence, and simplification gates without Go native plugins, DI, service locators, or a generic effect runtime.
